record.oneLiner: Twenty is an open-source CRM with dynamic REST and GraphQL APIs, API key/OAuth2 authentication, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server built into the platform.
record.verdictReason: Twenty offers comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs with self-serve API keys and OAuth2 authentication, plus an official built-in MCP server, making it fully buildable for AI toolkits.

evidence.quote: Create an API key in Settings → Developers → API → + Create key. Copy it immediately — it’s shown once.
| External app acting on behalf of a user | OAuth — Authorization Code |
| Free (Self-Hosted) | All Pro CRM features plus custom roles, AI on your own provider keys, community support |
Each workspace has its own schema — when you add a custom object (say Invoice), it immediately gets REST and GraphQL endpoints identical to built-in objects like Company or Person.
I was ultimately able to connect my self-hosted Twenty instance to ChatGPT through /mcp using OAuth successfully, without patching or modifying Twenty's OAuth implementation.
